game.name: Naruto : The Broken Bond (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Naruto: The Broken Bond for Xbox 360 follows on from its predecessor, Rise of a Ninja, and places us in the suit of the mischievous Konoha ninja. The game is a mix of action and adventure, and a more powerful Naruto. It's the second era of the series that you'll be roaming the Leaf Village in search of missions. Help Naruto find his friend Sasuke in the story mode. A multiplayer mode is also available for one-on-one battles.
